signature: SUBROUTINE DGGEVX( BALANC, JOBVL, JOBVR, SENSE, N, A, LDA, B, LDB,

params.name: balanc
jobvl
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the left generalized eigenvectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the left generalized eigenvectors.

params.name: jobvr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the right generalized eigenvectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the right generalized eigenvectors.

params.name: sense
N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A, B, `VL`, and `VR`. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in the pair (A,B). On exit, A has been overwritten. If `JOBVL='V'` or `JOBVR='V'` or both, then A contains the first part of the real Schur form of the "balanced" versions of the input A and B.
params.workDependent: the generalized Schur form S is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the matrix B in the pair (A,B). On exit, B has been overwritten. If `JOBVL='V'` or `JOBVR='V'` or both, then B contains the second part of the real Schur form of the "balanced" versions of the input A and B.
params.workDependent: the triangular T is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: BETA
params.reference:
On exit, (`ALPHAR(j)` + `ALPHAI(j)`\*i)/`BETA(j)`, $j=1$,...,N, will be the generalized eigenvalues. If `ALPHAI(j)` is zero, then the j-th eigenvalue is real; if positive, then the j-th and (j+1)-st eigenvalues are a complex conjugate pair, with `ALPHAI(j+1)` negative.

Note: the quotients `ALPHAR(j)`/`BETA(j)` and `ALPHAI(j)`/`BETA(j)` may easily over- or underflow, and `BETA(j)` may even be zero. Thus, the user should avoid naively computing the ratio ALPHA/`BETA`. However, `ALPHAR` and `ALPHAI` will be always less than and usually comparable with norm(A) in magnitude, and `BETA` always less than and usually comparable with norm(B).

params.name: VL
params.reference: If `JOBVL = 'V'`, the left eigenvectors u(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VL`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. If the j-th eigenvalue is real, then $u(j) = \mathrm{VL}(:,j)$, the j-th column of `VL`. If the j-th and (j+1)-th eigenvalues form a complex conjugate pair, then $u(j) = \mathrm{VL}(:,j)+i \, \mathrm{VL}(:,j+1)$ and $u(j+1) = \mathrm{VL}(:,j)-i \, \mathrm{VL}(:,j+1)$. Each eigenvector will be scaled so the largest component have abs(real part) + abs(imag. part) = 1. Not referenced if `JOBVL = 'N'`.
params.workDependent: each left eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVL = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference: If `JOBVR = 'V'`, the right eigenvectors v(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VR`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. If the j-th eigenvalue is real, then $v(j) = \mathrm{VR}(:,j)$, the j-th column of `VR`. If the j-th and (j+1)-th eigenvalues form a complex conjugate pair, then $v(j) = \mathrm{VR}(:,j)+i \, \mathrm{VR}(:,j+1)$ and $v(j+1) = \mathrm{VR}(:,j)-i \, \mathrm{VR}(:,j+1)$. Each eigenvector will be scaled so the largest component have abs(real part) + abs(imag. part) = 1. Not referenced if `JOBVR = 'N'`.
params.workDependent: each right eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVR = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` are integer values such that on exit $A(i,j) = 0$ and $B(i,j) = 0$ if $i > j$ and $j = 1$,...,`ILO`-1 or $i = \mathrm{IHI}+1$,...,N. If `BALANC = 'N'` or 'S', `ILO = 1` and `IHI = N`.

params.name: LSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the left side of A and B. If PL(j) is the index of the row interchanged with row j, and DL(j) is the scaling factor applied to row j, then

$$
\mathrm{LSCALE}(j) = \mathrm{PL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = 1, \cdots ,\mathrm{ILO}-1
$$

$$
= \mathrm{DL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{ILO}, \cdots ,\mathrm{IHI}
$$

$$
= \mathrm{PL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{IHI}+1, \cdots ,N
$$

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: RSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the right side of A and B. If PR(j) is the index of the column interchanged with column j, and DR(j) is the scaling factor applied to column j, then

$$
\mathrm{RSCALE}(j) = \mathrm{PR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = 1, \cdots ,\mathrm{ILO}-1
$$

$$
= \mathrm{DR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{ILO}, \cdots ,\mathrm{IHI}
$$

$$
= \mathrm{PR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{IHI}+1, \cdots ,N
$$

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: abnrm
params.reference: The one-norm of the balanced matrix A.

params.name: bbnrm
params.reference: The one-norm of the balanced matrix B.

params.name: RCONDE
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'E'` or 'B', the reciprocal condition numbers of the eigenvalues, stored in consecutive elements of the array. For a complex conjugate pair of eigenvalues two consecutive elements of `RCONDE` are set to the same value. Thus `RCONDE(j)`, `RCONDV(j)`, and the j-th columns of `VL` and `VR` all correspond to the j-th eigenpair. If `SENSE` = 'N or 'V', `RCONDE` is not referenced.

params.name: RCONDV
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'V'` or 'B', the estimated reciprocal condition numbers of the eigenvectors, stored in consecutive elements of the array. For a complex eigenvector two consecutive elements of `RCONDV` are set to the same value. If the eigenvalues cannot be reordered to compute `RCONDV(j)`, `RCONDV(j)` is set to 0; this can only occur when the true value would be very small anyway. If `SENSE = 'N'` or 'E', `RCONDV` is not referenced.
params.workDependent: DTGSNA's DIF estimate is computed from the Schur form, whose signs the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N)$. If `BALANC = 'S'` or 'B', or `JOBVL = 'V'`, or `JOBVR = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,6 \, N)$. If `SENSE = 'E'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,10 \, N)$. If `SENSE = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 2 \, N \, N+8 \, N+16$.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'E'`, `IWORK` is not referenced.

params.name: BWORK
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'N'`, `BWORK` is not referenced.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `= 1,...,N`:  The QZ iteration failed.  No eigenvectors have been calculated, but `ALPHAR(j)`, `ALPHAI(j)`, and `BETA(j)` should be correct for $j=\mathrm{INFO}+1$,...,N.
-   `> N`: =N+1: other than QZ iteration failed in DHGEQZ. =N+2: error return from DTGEVC.

checks.fortran: .NOT.( LSAME( BALANC, 'N' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'S' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'P' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'B' ) )

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local MINWRK is assigned inside nested control flow

overrides.reason: DGGEVX hands its LWORK to DGEQRF, DORMQR and DORGQR, which pick their block size from LWORK and fall back to unblocked code when it is short of the optimum. The blocked and unblocked QR steps round differently, and the QZ iteration that follows can then reach a generalized Schur form (S,T) whose rows and columns differ by signs, with eigenvectors scaled by -1 (real) or by a different complex unit (complex pairs); DTGSNA's DIF estimate (RCONDV), computed from that Schur form, moves with it. ALPHAR, ALPHAI, BETA and RCONDE do not depend on LWORK beyond rounding; the module's tests check them, and RCONDV within a factor 2, at the minimum WORK past the blocking threshold (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: the generalized Schur form S is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.B.workDependent: the triangular T is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.VL.workDependent: each left eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.VR.workDependent: each right eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.RCONDV.workDependent: DTGSNA's DIF estimate is computed from the Schur form, whose signs the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
